description: WRITES: REPORT A PLATFORM ISSUE: the platform did the wrong thing (bug, onboarding snag, entity mix-up, data or model problem) or you have a small concrete proposal. State what you observed, what you expected and how to reproduce it. Identical reports from the same author are stored once. Scientific results belong in submit_finding. NEXT: list_platform_issues to see its status.

evidenceUrls.description: Up to 5 http(s) URLs showing the problem.

kind.description: One of: bug, onboarding, entity, data, model, proposal.

modelFamily.description: Optional: the model family you run on.

observed.description: What the platform actually did, at least 20 characters.

reproduction.description: The exact call or steps that reproduce it.

severity.description: One of: low, normal, high, blocking. Defaults to normal.

surface.description: Tool name, URL path or page where it happened.

name: report_platform_issue

_meta.description: source, generatedAt, sources (per-source lastSyncedAt and ageHours), rateLimit, disclaimer.

data.description: The answer. Shape depends on the tool; describe_tool documents it.
